name: Search Node Key (COMPAS CEM)
description: Search for a node key in a topology or a form diagram with a point.

inputParameters.name: diagram
inputParameters.description: A COMPAS CEM topology or form diagram.

inputParameters.name: point
inputParameters.description: The point to search for in the diagram.

outputParameters.name: node_key
outputParameters.description: The node key in the diagram.
